name: No Tool Harvest from Empty Sources
description: A cutting tool is no longer used up on a blackberry bush that has no berries left: a villager dropped to harvest it with a cutting tool refuses, as at an empty bush ("There is not enough to harvest.", the game's own words), and keeps the tool. With 1 berry or more the harvest works exactly as before (it brings what is left, at most 30). **With "Cloth Sacks for Yellow Fruit" ticked too, the same goes for the cloth sacks: a sack is not made for a yellow fruit tree with no fruit left (which happens only with "Yellow Fruit Trees are No Longer Unlimited"; otherwise the tree never runs out), and no cloth is used. Without Cloth Sacks this patch does the cutting tool alone.** **Needs no other patch.** **On by default.** **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.** The companion is "VVFP VV4 Empty Sources.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; if the DLL cannot be loaded, the stock game runs.
behavior_changes: The cutting-tool harvest's drop (0x46E7E0, map area 0x31): after its own 'no tool' check, with 0 berries the villager gets action 0x3F with text 0xA7 ("There is not enough to harvest.", the empty bush's refusal at 0x46F881) and no tool is used (0x4369F0 is not called); with 1 or more, unchanged.

Cloth Sacks for Yellow Fruit ("VVFP VV4 Cloth Sacks.dll") asks whether "VVFP VV4 Empty Sources.dll" is loaded (GetModuleHandleW); when it is and the yellow fruit tree holds 0 fruit (VvfpYellowFruitLeft of "VVFP VV4 Fruit Supply.dll"), a drop at the hut gets the same refusal (action 0x3F, text 0xA7) after the 'no cloth' check and before any cloth is used.
explicit_non_changes: At 1 or more berries or fruit the tool and the sack take what is left, as before (job event 14 and the sack's event: at most 30). Picking, the fruit trips and every other drop are the game's own.
The pruning puzzle's use of a tool at the same spot (0x46E84C, puzzle 0xC) is not changed.
No executable byte is patched: the companion writes one jump at run time after verifying the site and the code it returns to; nothing is written to the save.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; emulated (an empty bush refused with the tool kept, 1 berry harvested as before, the stock game using the tool; an empty limited tree refused at the hut with the cloth kept, with and without the companion) in tests/test_vv4_empty_sources.py; runtime/player confirmation pending

runtime_detours.routine: the cutting-tool harvest's drop 0x46E7E0, its tool use (push esi / push 1 / call 0x4369F0 on 0x4D8614): with 0 berries ([game + 0x170F8]) the empty bush's own refusal (action 0x3F, text 0xA7) and the drop's end 0x46E89B instead, no tool used; otherwise the stock instructions and on at 0x46E877
runtime_detours.installed_by: VVFP VV4 Empty Sources.dll, VvfpStartup (started by VVFP Startup.dll, second word)
